title: Pride and Prejudice Section 1: True/False and Comprehension Questions on the Bennets
summary: Exercises on an extract from Pride and Prejudice about the Bennet family and Mr Bingley's arrival, including true/false statements, comprehension questions about the characters' motivations, and Mr Bennet's views on Lizzy.

title: Pride and Prejudice Section 1: Vocabulary Matching and Writing about Mr Bennet's Visit
summary: Vocabulary exercises asking students to find synonyms from the text and complete sentences with the correct words, followed by a writing task imagining Mr Bennet's conversation with Mr Bingley.

title: Pride and Prejudice Section 2: Multiple Choice and True/False Exercises on the Ball Scene
summary: Multiple choice and true/false comprehension exercises based on an extract about the ball, covering Mr Darcy's reluctance to dance, Elizabeth's reaction to his comments, and Mrs Bennet's opinions of Mr Bingley and Mr Darcy.

title: Pride and Prejudice Section 2: Vocabulary, Character Matching and Writing Task
summary: A vocabulary synonym exercise, a character identification activity linking characters to actions from the ball scene, and a creative writing task imagining a conversation between Elizabeth and Mr Darcy.

title: Pride and Prejudice Section 3: Ordering Events, Character Matching and Questions
summary: Exercises on an extract where the Bingley sisters and others discuss Elizabeth, including ordering events chronologically, matching characters to statements, and comprehension questions about social class and appearance.

title: Pride and Prejudice Section 3: Vocabulary Exercise and Letter Writing as Elizabeth
summary: A synonym-matching vocabulary activity based on the Bingley sisters' conversation about Elizabeth, followed by a creative writing task where students write a letter from Elizabeth expressing her feelings.

title: Pride and Prejudice Section 4: True/False and Questions on Mr Wickham's Story
summary: Comprehension exercises on an extract about Mr Wickham's account of his dispute with Mr Darcy over inheritance, including true/false statements and questions about Wickham's motives and Elizabeth's reactions.

title: Pride and Prejudice Section 4: Vocabulary, Sentence Completion and Writing as Mr Darcy's Father
summary: Vocabulary exercises finding synonyms from the Wickham extract, sentence completion using those words, and a creative writing task imagining a letter from the late Mr Darcy explaining his will's terms.
